mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS record_id, r.user_id, r.book_id, r.borrowed_at, r.returned_at, u.username, b.title AS book_title, b.deleted AS book_deleted FROM borrow_records AS r JOIN users AS u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN books AS b ON b.id = r.book_id ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT r.id AS record_id, r.user_id, r.book_id, r.borrowed_at, r.returned_at, u.username, b.title AS book_title, b.deleted AS book_deleted FROM borrow_records AS r JOIN users AS u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN books AS b ON b.id = r.book_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_records WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND returned_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM borrow_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND returned_at IS NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_records (user_id, book_id, borrowed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowedAt})
